feature: Hidden RTF formatting no longer removes table cell/row boundaries
rootCause: cell/nestcell/row/nestrow used appendText and were suppressed by hidden character state. Visible cells could concatenate and empty cell positions disappear. The nesttableprops path emitted a row separately.
fix: Emit table structure independently of character visibility after Unicode fallback and destination decisions, with shared paragraph/hidden-reference state reset for regular and nested row marks. Hidden text, skipped destinations and discarded note streams remain isolated.

fixtures.generation: Deterministic 6 bodies x4 visibility patterns x3 containers plus 8 table shapes x2 nesting levels x3 formatting contexts. No randomness.
fixtures.preliminaryInputs: The first expanded-before local run included extra unused cell definitions. Canonical expanded sources have exactly matching cell definitions; the preliminary run is preserved locally and excluded from counts.

oracles.path: Actual RTF import -> unmodified HTML -> Chrome visible cells; original HTML and hashes retained in expanded-before.json.
referenceLimitations: 24 original Unicode-fallback cases expose native handling differences: fallback control counts and braces follow the specification in the reader, not the conflicting Writer result.
Two character-style empty cells have an empty p/br placeholder with innerText exactly newline; native raw output is retained and empty cell position remains part of the comparison.

results.notes: Footnote/endnote table content remains in its own stream; actual anchor dispatch reaches target; whole hidden note omitted.
results.recovery: Broken binary length produces error; later normal file opens and stale RTF read cannot overwrite CURRENT.
results.screenshots: Both before/after comparisons inspected: separate visible words and the empty middle-cell interval restored. Not a geometry match.

validation.diffCheckNote: Staged new-file check caught an extra blank line at EOF; removed in followup before PR, with no test behavior change.

limitations: Reader remains a text/table-separator view: no full cell geometry, merged-cell layout, borders or original pagination.
12 original explicit hidden paragraph-mark differences remain pending application-policy review; this change does not silently reinterpret their earlier contract.
No WeChat WXML, developer tools or physical-device validation in this batch.
No claim of complete RTF support or hidden-text display UI.
